title: 第006章 不能让你们父女相认
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

洗手间狭窄，谢亭渝挡在她身前，像一座山。

舒楹被围得密不透风，灼热的气息熏得她产生了某种奇怪的眩晕感。

她不敢看他，视线停在他几乎看不出痕迹的唇畔，脸红得要命。

这是比躲在车上听他们交谈更窒息的处境，而她挣脱不了。

“……我在。”舒楹隐隐感觉许栀意就在门后，在事情变得更早之前回答了她。

“薛姨今天没腾开手，我想着我离这近，就给你打包了我常吃的这家鳗鱼饭，你快来吃别凉了。”

绵绵还在睡，许栀意有意控制了说话的分贝。但对舒楹来说，仍然是一种折磨。

“我这就来。”舒楹找到机会推开谢亭渝，欲盖弥彰地按下抽水马桶的按钮。

“好，我帮你把饭

她欲盖弥彰地

舒楹装作没看到，顶着压力走出洗手间再把门关上。

许栀意买的鳗鱼饭包装精致，味道鲜美，显得她的便利店饭团特别寒碜。

“幸好我来了，不然你就这样随便对付着吃饭。”不知是不是小情侣的默契，许栀意的口吻某种程度上和谢亭渝相差无几。

舒楹沉默吃饭，嘴巴里鲜甜的鳗鱼还没咽下去，苦涩感先涌了上来。

他们很般配，把她衬成了莫名其妙出现捣乱的恶毒女配，尽管她从没想过要破坏他们。

许栀意午休时间有限，没等她吃完，接了个预约电话急匆匆地走了，“姐，我明天再来。”

病房门开了又关，舒楹下意识停下筷子。

洗手间里依然没有动静。

同一时间，床上的绵绵翻了个身坐起来，刚要喊妈妈，视线里多了个没见过的陌生男人。

她揉了揉眼睛，歪着头喊了一句：“粑粑？”

舒楹顿时僵住了，手里的筷子差点掉到地上。

谢亭渝第一次正眼看绵绵。

她和她妈妈很像，眨巴着乌溜溜的大眼睛，玉雪可爱，因为生病了更加惹人怜惜。

可惜她对上的人是谢亭渝。

“你喊谁？”他脸上不见喜色，一张浓墨重彩的脸正极力压着不爽，气息很冷。

The bathroom was narrow, and Xie Tingyu stood in front of her like a mountain.

Shu Ying was surrounded tightly, and the hot breath made her feel strangely dizzy.

She didn't dare to look at him, her eyes stopped on his barely visible lips, and she blushed terribly.

It was a more suffocating situation than hiding in the car listening to their conversation, and she couldn't escape.

"...I'm here." Shu Ying vaguely felt that Xu Zhiyi was behind the door and answered her before things got worse.

"Aunt Xue didn't move her hands today. I thought I was close here, so I packed the eel rice I often eat for you. Come and eat it before it gets cold."

Mianmian was still sleeping, and Xu Zhiyi deliberately controlled the decibel level of her speech.But for Shu Ying, it was still a torture.

"I'll come right away." Shu Ying found the opportunity to push Xie Tingyu away, and pressed the toilet button in a covert manner.

"Okay, I'll help you with the food

She tried to hide it

Shu Ying pretended not to see it, walked out of the bathroom under pressure and closed the door.

The eel rice Xu Zhiyi bought was exquisitely packaged and delicious, making her convenience store rice balls look particularly shabby.

"Fortunately I'm here, otherwise you would just eat casually like this."I wonder if it's a tacit understanding between the young lovers, but Xu Zhiyi's tone is almost the same as Xie Tingyu's to some extent.

Shu Ying ate in silence. Before she could swallow the sweet eel in her mouth, a bitter taste came to her.

They're a perfect match, making her the villainous heroine who appears out of nowhere to cause trouble, even though she never means to sabotage them.

Xu Zhiyi's lunch break was limited, so before she could finish her meal, she took a reservation call and left in a hurry, "Sister, I'll come back tomorrow."

The ward door opened and closed, and Shu Ying subconsciously stopped her chopsticks.

There was still no movement in the bathroom.

At the same time, Mianmian turned over and sat up on the bed. Just as he was about to call his mother, a strange man he had never seen before appeared in his sight.

She rubbed her eyes, tilted her head and shouted: "Daddy?"

Shu Ying froze immediately and almost dropped the chopsticks in his hand to the ground.

Xie Tingyu looked at Mianmian for the first time.

She is very similar to her mother, blinking her big black eyes, Yuxue is cute, and even more pitiable because she is sick.

Unfortunately, the person she faced was Xie Tingyu.

"Who are you calling?"There was no joy on his face. He was trying his best to suppress his displeasure with a heavily painted face, and his breath was very cold.
